EPM Meter Software Option Upgrade Instructions 
Technical Note 
GE Vernova Multilin Publication Number: GET-20081 
Copyright © 2019 GE Vernova Multilin 
Overview 
EPM meters are equipped with Software Option technology, a virtual firmware-based switch that lets you enable 
features through software communication. Upgrading the Software Option allows feature upgrades after installation 
without removing the meter from service. 
To upgrade an EPM meter Software Option and unlock additional functionality, provide the following information to 
the GE Vernova Grid Solutions Sales team: 
• Existing Software Option (or Model Number)
• Desired Software Option
• Meter Serial Number (including leading zeros)
• Payment details (purchase order, etc.)
The meter serial number and model number/software option are both on the label attached to the EPM meter or 
can be found through the GE Vernova Communicator software if the meter is not easily accessible. 
Once an encrypted Software Option key has been obtained, the EPM meter can be upgraded using the GE 
Vernova Communicator software. 
Find the model number and serial number from the meter label 
1. Locate the label affixed to the back or side of your EPM meter.
In the picture shown, an EPM 7000P is used as an example.

heading: Find the software option and serial number using GE Communicator software

Find the software option and serial number using GE Vernova Communicator software 
1. Open the GE Vernova Communicator software application.
2. From the menu select Tools > Device Information. The Device Status window opens.
3. Record the Serial Number and Software Option, as indicated above.
Enable the new EPM meter Software Option 
Once you have received an encrypted Software Option key from GE Vernova Grid Solutions, the meter can be upgraded 
as follows: 1. Open the GE Vernova Communicator software.
2. Power up your EPM meter.
3. Connect to the EPM meter through GE Vernova Communicator software (see the meter manual 
for details).
4. Click Tools > Change Software Option from the Title Bar.
A screen opens, requesting the encrypted key.
5. Enter the Software Option key provided by GE Vernova Grid Solutions and click Update.
The
 new Software Option functionality is enabled, and the EPM meter resets.
For more information about EPM meters, visit our website at: https://www.gevernova.com/grid-solutions/automation/protection-
control-metering
